# GharInspect

> Professional home inspection for new-possession and resale property in India.
> Certified civil and structural engineers, 250+ checkpoints, thermal imaging,
> and a photo-documented digital report within 24 hours.

## Services
Pre-possession and resale property inspection covering civil, electrical,
plumbing and finishing work. Findings are photo-documented and referenced to
measurable standards so they can be raised with a builder as a snag list.

## Pricing
- Starter — ₹5,000 — 1 BHK
- Professional — ₹6,000 — 2 BHK
- Premium — ₹7,000 — 3+ BHK
- Enterprise — custom quote — villas and commercial

## Coverage
Pune, Mumbai, Thane, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Delhi NCR.
